name: typescript-strict-package
title: TypeScript Strict Library
description: Publishable strict TypeScript package: tsup dual builds, Vitest, Biome, Changesets, no-any discipline, and explicit public API typing.

registry.note: Written for library authors — the strict-tsconfig flag set (noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes) and the 'no runtime dep under 50 lines' rule come from real ORM/tooling codebases, not a blog post.
